blocks.title: View model note
blocks.text: Keep a render-ready view model separate from raw payloads to avoid expensive transforms on every tick.
Comment order, moderation, and follow-mode ownership

Separate comment entities from ordered timeline IDs, contiguous sequence, opaque stream cursor, moderation revision, follow mode, and composer commands. A tombstone retains identity and layout context without exposing removed content. The new-item counter derives from accepted IDs not yet placed into the paused viewport, rather than from every transport frame.
